verdict: Yes, for a founder who understands grassroots India. Haqdarshak pitched a platform to help people and MSMEs discover welfare schemes on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from three sharks. Many eligible people never apply for schemes, and helping them can be paid for by companies, banks and governments.
angle: India has hundreds of central and state schemes, but most people don't know which ones they qualify for. Field agents and apps can help them apply. Revenue comes from companies, banks and CSR programmes that want to reach these users.
